_about: Geerhardus Vos (1862-1949), professor of Biblical theology at Princeton: The Teaching of Jesus concerning the Kingdom of God and the Church (New York: American Tract Society, 1903); Grace and Glory, sermons preached in the chapel of Princeton Seminary (Grand Rapids: Reformed Press, 1922); The Self-Disclosure of Jesus (New York: Doran, 1926). All are US publications before 1930, so public domain in the US. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
